jobs_results.description:

• Optimizar los procesos, contribuir al buen funcionamiento del departamento haciendo seguimiento a los sprints quincenales.

• Experiencia contrastada en principios SOLID para desarrollar código más limpio, más mantenible, más escalable y menos propenso a errores.
• Experiencia en la realización de test

jobs_results.title: Nedatec Consulting, S.l.: Desarrollador de .NET
jobs_results.description:
Nedatec Consulting, S.l. busca un/a Desarrollador de .NET

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un programador/a apasionado/a y experimentado/a para unirse a nuestro equipo y contribuir al desarrollo y perfeccionamiento de nuestro aplicativo Prevengos, diseñado para la gestión de la prevención de riesgos laborales, medicina ocupacional y coordinación de actividades empresariales.

Tareas
• Desarrollo de nuestro aplicativo Prevengos.
• Contribuir en todas las fases del ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software, desde la concepción hasta la implementación y soporte.
• Análisis y desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades.
• Garantizar la calidad y el rendimiento del aplicativo mediante pruebas y corrección de errores.
• Documentar el desarrollo y mantenimiento del software de manera clara y concisa.

Requisitos
• Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Software o campo relacionado.
• Experiencia comprobada en programación con ASP .NET, Visual Studio .NET, JavaScript, CSS... Bootstrap y experiencia con bases de datos SQL Server.
• Se valorará conocimientos en desarrollos de aplicaciones móviles
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y en equipo, con un enfoque en soluciones y resultados.
• Excelente capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.
• Se valorará experiencia trabajando con Git y GitHub.

Beneficios
• Contrato fijo con un paquete salarial muy competitivo.
• Excelente ambiente laboral en un equipo dinámico y colaborativo.
• Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo de habilidades.

Si estás interesado en formar parte de nuestra empresa, no dudes en apuntarte a nuestra oferta de trabajo

jobs_results.title: Softwareentwickler/In, C#-Entwickler/In,Informatiker/In
jobs_results.description: IT, Industrie 4.0, Frontend, Softwareentwicklung, Human-Machine Interfaces, Informatik, Backend, DevOps, Softwarearchitektur, E-Learning, Windows Presentation Foundation, C#, .NET How are modern e-cigarettes actually made? Who is behind the production of paper straws? And how are washing machine pods and dishwasher tabs produced? The machines of the Tembo Group are behind all of these products. As a so-called hidden champion, Tembo has become a global player in the construction, automation and development of innovative machine platforms. At our German location ITM Germany - in Schwalmtal near Mönchengladbach - we develop control systems and concepts based on the latest technologies for Tembo Group production machines with around 30 employees. The aim here is to combine the various disciplines, such as high-speed processes and quality assurance systems, with the aspects of Industry 4.0. Our products are used worldwide by well-known customers such as Philip Morris, Tetra Pak and Henkel... Sounds exciting? Then become part of our team as Software Developer C#/.NET (m/f/d) Schwalmtal, permanent, full-time The job: As a C#/.NET developer, you are an important part of our interdisciplinary development team and ensure that our user-friendly machines are equipped with modern WPF applications. In collaboration with colleagues from the fields of electrical engineering, design, automation, project management and process engineering, you will design software architectures and select the technologies required for this. From HMI, I4.0 connections and data collection to process analysis software, real-time applications and internal development tools: The C#/.NET applications you develop are used in both the frontend and the backend. In a nutshell - what you bring to the table: Degree in computer engineering or electrical engineering or: completed training in these areas plus professional experience in software development or: experience in the development of production-related software as a career changer Good knowledge of C# - for example in .NET Framework 4/4.5/4.8, .NET Standard, WPF, Microsoft DevOps or Resharper in addition to a good knowledge of German, a good command of written and spoken English Willingness to learn about our technologies and target industries Creativity, commitment, problem-solving skills, flexibility and the ability to work as part of a team - right? Our benefits for you: Induction: Thanks to the close cooperation with your colleagues, the induction process runs like clockwork. We invest between 6 and 12 months in your internal training. Your work location: For your work in the office, you have access to newly renovated premises, state-of-the-art IT equipment and e-charging stations for your car. Salary: You will receive 13 salaries including Christmas and vacation bonuses. You can invest part of this in a company pension scheme if you wish. The team: Our young, small team not only offers you great development opportunities, but also a high degree of creative freedom. Working hours: Thanks to our flexitime system, you can organize your working hours flexibly. You can work off any overtime or have it paid out. You have the option of doing some of your work from home. The other benefits: You will receive a permanent employment contract, can use our e-learning platform GoodHabitz and benefit from the existence of our works council. We also offer the purchase of job bikes. Are you excited? Then apply by e-mail to ******. Questions about the job? Please call our Managing Director Heiko Thielen on 02163 -3381-0. ITM Germany GmbH Amerner Str. 51 41366 Schwalmtal Phone +49 2163 33810 www.itmgroup.eu

jobs_results.title: Programador .NET con motores gráficos 100% remoto
jobs_results.description:
En Fihoca estamos creciendo y buscamos incorporar un perfil de Programador .NET con experiencia en motores gráficos para trabajar 100% remoto en proyectos internacionales del sector logistico

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

-Desarrollo de evolutivos

-Correctivos sobre una aplicación basada en un motor gráfico

-Presentación de planos en 2D y 3D basados en productos del sector logistico

¿Que necesitamos de ti?

Informática o Formación Universitaria preferiblemente en Ingenierías como Informática, Industrial o Telecomunicaciones

Al menos 3 años de experiencia en la creación de código limpio con C#

Al menos 3 años de experiencia desarrollo .NET con motores gráficos

Al menos 3 años con conocimientos y experiencia en el uso de frameworks de dibujo y motores gráficos (2D/3D), tanto en versiones escritorio como versiones Web (WEBGI, OpenGL, Unity, Direct3d, ...)

Conocimiento y experiencia en matemática vectorial

Conocimiento completo en cómo aplicar los principios SOLID

Conocimiento... completo en cómo utilizar los patrones de diseño más comunes.

Experiencia en implementar Unit test

.NET Framework > 4.8

Saber para qué sirve y como aplicar de forma correcta IoC

Experiencia en la gestión de push, pull con el repositorio GIT y saber cómo resolver conflictos de código.

Capacidad de encontrar soluciones por ti mismo además de pedir ayuda cuando lo necesites

Prestar atención a los detalles

Buenas prácticas de desarrollo (CleanCode, Organización y Performance)

¿Qué te podemos ofrecer?

-Crecimiento profesional

-Posición estable y contrato indefinido.

-Modalidad de trabajo híbrido

-Plan de retribución flexible (Ticket restaurante, seguro médico, transporte)

-Beneficios para la conciliación familiar

-Formación

Nos dedicamos a ofrecer soluciones tecnológicas de vanguardia, estrategias de negocio visionarias y al desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones que definen el futuro.

Actualmente seguimos en crecimiento, por ello estamos en búsqueda del mejor talento tecnológico en Alicante. jobs_results.title: .net Developer IT (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are / Our Client Company In Austria

Nexos is a private HR recruiting and consulting company. We operate on the international recruiting market and are looking for experts to work in the Austrian job market.

The modern world of work is frequently characterised by considerable uncertainty and largescale change. By contrast, our client offers crisis-proof jobs for the long-term. The company has a precise understanding of the logistics sector. Their goal is to satisfy their customers throughout Austria with quality products and the reliable delivery of services in the mail, banking, telecommunications, and energy fields. To achieve this aim, the company place great emphasis on an appreciative and open working environment.

What you will work on
• Participate in all Agile meetings
• Participate in the analysis, design, and cost estimate of existing or new software components an solutions
• Define and develop interfaces between individual components, data structures, user... interfaces and software components
• Plan work steps for greater economy and efficiency in coordination with the Solution Architect
• Implement functional requirements based on the defined software architecture and utilize program libraries, frameworks, and tool suitable for this purpose
• Coach team members, perform code reviews and monitor compliance with our coding guidelines. We encourage pair programming, mutual code reviews and knowledge exchange within the team and we are always looking for new ideas about how to modernize applications. To achieve these aims, we rely on a modern IT architecture (Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, etc.) and new technologies for applications which have already been transformed (e.g., Azure Cloud Hosting)

What you bring with you
• Programming knowledge in .NET/C# and Knowledge of MS SQL
• Experience with webservices (WCF, REST) and version control (GIT, TFS)
• Experience with unit testing and test automation
• Experience with Microsoft’s cloud technologies, especially the Azure platform
• Knowledge of DevOps, especially the automated provision of cloud services through Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., PowerShell, ARM templates, Terraform)
• Relevant practical experience in working in and with Agile product organisations

Offer
• Food vouchers as well as occupational health promotion
• A free employee bank account
• Discounted holiday offers in one of our many holiday homes
• A gross annual salary starting from EUR 50,000, all-in

Your Nexos Recruitment Team awaits your application.

________________________________________

Contact

We are looking forward to your informative application in GERMAN or ENGLISH LANGUAGE! Send us your application with CV including your photo.

Applications in other languages (e.g. Spanish) will not be accepted.

Please use the format Europass – pdf file.

Send your application to: info@nexos.at

What you will work on
• Participate in all Agile meetings
• Participate in the analysis, design, and cost estimate of existing or new software components an solutions
• Define and develop interfaces between individual components, data structures, user... interfaces and software components
• Plan work steps for greater economy and efficiency in coordination with the Solution Architect
• Implement functional requirements based on the defined software architecture and utilize program libraries, frameworks, and tool suitable for this purpose
• Coach team members, perform code reviews and monitor compliance with our coding guidelines. We encourage pair programming, mutual code reviews and knowledge exchange within the team and we are always looking for new ideas about how to modernize applications. To achieve these aims, we rely on a modern IT architecture (Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, etc.) and new technologies for applications which have already been transformed (e.g., Azure Cloud Hosting)

What you bring with you
• Programming knowledge in .NET/C# and Knowledge of MS SQL
• Experience with webservices (WCF, REST) and version control (GIT, TFS)
• Experience with unit testing and test automation
• Experience with Microsoft’s cloud technologies, especially the Azure platform
• Knowledge of DevOps, especially the automated provision of cloud services through Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., PowerShell, ARM templates, Terraform)
• Relevant practical experience in working in and with Agile product organisations

Offer
• Food vouchers as well as occupational health promotion
• A free employee bank account
• Discounted holiday offers in one of our many holiday homes
• A gross annual salary starting from EUR 50,000, all-in

Your Nexos Recruitment Team awaits your application.

________________________________________

Contact

We are looking forward to your informative application in GERMAN or ENGLISH LANGUAGE! Send us your application with CV including your photo.

Applications in other languages (e.g. Spanish) will not be accepted.

Please use the format Europass – pdf file.

Send your application to: info@nexos.at

jobs_results.title: .NET Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

Quantion is a Business Digital Transformation services company born in 2015.

We have +120 professionals in application development, UX/UI and digital business transformation to build innovative solutions oriented to business results.

We combine our teams in cutting-edge technologies and digital deep experiences with the innovation ecosystem, to ensure that we can provide the best solution to face business challenges, from its concept to its implementation.

We are looking for .NET DEVELOPER to join our Tech Team. If you want to participate in one of our biggest International projects, don’t hesitate to apply!

What you will do:
• You will be part of a product team that owns and manages all phases of the software development lifecycle (planning, design, implementation, deployment, and support)
• You will contribute to the front-end and back-end development of a product
• You will design, build, and maintain API infrastructure that allows for modern integration methods... between applications
• You will work pragmatically and support my team to deliver high-quality solutions to our customers
• You will communicate technical ideas and set the direction for the team’s product with a focus on delivering customer value
• You will work in an international environment with a highly diverse team

Required skills:
• At least 5 years of experience as a full stack web engineer
• Deep experience with .NET Core, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML.
• Deep experience with building microservices and RESTful APIs.
• Strong knowledge of DevOps tools and processes (e.g., Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes)
• Strong knowledge of software quality assurance and secure software development (e.g., unit testing, functional testing, static code analysis)
• Some knowledge of cloud computing platforms like Microsoft Azure
• Some knowledge of cloud storage, databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), distributed message brokers and/or distributed event-streaming platforms
• Demonstrable ability to work in cross-functional DevOps teams
• Very good command of the English language

Apply to our offer…

💟 If you are passionate about technologies

💟 If you define yourself as a team worker

💟 If you want to work with a multidisciplinary and international team

💟 If you want to be part of a company which is permanently expanding and growing

💟 If you want to work in an international environment

Our offering:

✨ Permanent contract

✨ Competitive salary

✨ 22 days of vacation

✨ 5 additional holidays for Christmas

✨ 4 additional holidays for Easter

✨ Flexible working time

✨ Continuous working days in summer

Committed to equality, at Quantion we believe in diversity and inclusion. We defend equal opportunities without discriminating based on gender, age, religion or sexual orientation or any other aspect that could be considered exclusive
